question: Should OpenClaw add a `HEARTBEAT.md` task-level model metadata contract, or should heartbeat model selection wait for a broader per-turn/model-router API or plugin hook design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable fix changes public heartbeat task syntax, batching behavior, provider/model precedence, and session/fallback semantics.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable per-turn or heartbeat routing contract before accepting heartbeat-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only task metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow `HEARTBEAT.md` task model field with explicit split/group semantics, provider validation, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Route to whole-turn plugin policy
options.body: Decline task-level core syntax and document whole-turn routing through `before_model_resolve`, accepting that multiple due tasks cannot be routed independently today.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable per-turn or heartbeat routing contract before accepting heartbeat-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses heartbeat runtime behavior, config/product surface, and the existing model-hook extension seam.
